goal_a_reason: Free-text greeting replies require semantic similarity scoring to tolerate paraphrasing (e.g. 'Hi Alice!' vs 'Hello, Alice!'); no tool-call inspection is needed.
goal_b_reason: Structured JSON output with a known expected object is best scored deterministically with tree-based comparison that tolerates key ordering and minor whitespace without an LLM.
goal_c_reason: Pass/fail on whether a literal substring appears anywhere in the output is exactly what the binary contains evaluator is designed for.
